facts.fact: Jo 独自上门，带皮质托特包与一束粉色芍药。
facts.anchor: Jo Allard stands on the doorstep, a leather tote slung over one shoulder, holding out a bouquet of pink peonies.

facts.fact: Jo 自称周日离开、昨夜才回，回来才听说。
facts.anchor: “I left town on Sunday afternoon and didn’t get back until last night, and that’s when I heard.”

facts.fact: Jo 咬定 Caren 只是喝到微醺，并抬出 Foster 家作证。
facts.anchor: “Caren, sweetie. You were tipsy. The Fosters saw you stumble.”

facts.fact: Caren 在厨房用最大的刀剁掉花茎泄愤。
facts.anchor: I lay the flowers on a cutting board, seize my biggest knife, and savagely chop off their ends.

facts.fact: Jo 的出身是长岛工人阶级，家族做渔民与消防员。
facts.anchor: Her roots were working-class Long Island, where her extended family worked as fishermen and firefighters.

facts.fact: Daniel 父亲在法国经营制药公司，这笔钱让 Allard 家变了样。
facts.anchor: He’d owned a pharmaceutical company in France, and the money that came to the Allards transformed them.

facts.fact: Jo 被撞见翻看装首饰的塑料盒，却毫无愧色。
facts.anchor: She looks up from the plastic box that contains the ziplock bags of jewelry, caught in the act but utterly unashamed.

facts.fact: Rachel 以 walk-on 身份被 Georgetown 招入。
facts.anchor: And she was recruited as a walk-on at Georgetown.

facts.fact: 礼物是已停产的网球拍钥匙扣，二手价约 350 美元。
facts.anchor: A key chain—a cult item, discontinued several years ago and reselling for about three hundred and fifty dollars.

facts.fact: 盒中卡片署名 Jo 与 Daniel，期待明年在 Georgetown 看 Rachel 比赛。
facts.anchor: Can’t wait to see you play at Georgetown next year! xo Jo and Daniel
